QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: surveyInAccuracyLimit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The minimum accuracy value that Survey-In must achieve before it can complete.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: surveyInMinObservationDuration
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the minimum amount of observation time for the position calculation.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: useFixedBasePosition
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Specify the values for the RTK base position without having to do a survey in.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionLatitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the latitude of the fixed RTK base position.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionLongitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the longitude of the fixed RTK base position.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the altitude of the fixed RTK base position.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionAccuracy
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the accuracy of the fixed RTK base position.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmSourceType
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Selects where RTCM correction data is obtained from and forwarded to the vehicle.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripHost
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hostname or IP address of the NTRIP caster.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: TCP port of the NTRIP caster.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripMountpoint
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Mountpoint / stream name on the NTRIP caster.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripUsername
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Username for NTRIP caster authentication (leave empty if not required).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripPassword
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Password for NTRIP caster authentication (leave empty if not required).

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ntripSendGGA
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Periodically send the vehicle position as an NMEA GGA sentence to the caster. Required for VRS / network-RTK mountpoints.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tcpHost
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hostname or IP address of the raw RTCM3 TCP source.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tcpPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: TCP port of the raw RTCM3 source.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: udpPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Local UDP port to receive raw RTCM3 datagrams on.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: logRtcmToFile
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Save the incoming raw RTCM3 stream to a file on disk.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmLogPath
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Path of the file to save the raw RTCM3 stream to. Leave empty to use a timestamped file in the application log directory.
